fields.description: Transaction: inspect when a document moves the stock. Periodic Re-test: re-inspect stored batches on an interval — due batches are auto-quarantined into the Quality Control warehouse.
fields.label: Trigger Type

fields.description: Days between re-inspections of a stored batch, counted from the batch's manufacturing date or its last inspection decision.
fields.label: Re-test Interval (Days)
Document Type
fields.options:
Purchase Receipt
Purchase Invoice
Subcontracting Receipt
Delivery Note
Sales Invoice
Stock Entry

fields.description: Applies only to Stock Entry. Use one row per Stock Entry Type (e.g. one row for Material Receipt, another for Material Transfer).
fields.label: Stock Entry Type

fields.depends_on: eval:doc.trigger_type != 'Periodic Re-test' && (['Purchase Receipt','Purchase Invoice','Delivery Note','Sales Invoice'].includes(doc.document_type))
fields.description: Defaults to External — most companies do not inspect internal (inter-company) transfers. To cover both, add a second row for Internal Transfer.
fields.label: Transaction Type

fields.description: Inbound = stock entering a warehouse (target); Outbound = stock leaving (source). Auto-set for document types that allow only one direction. For Delivery Note and Sales Invoice, Outbound inspects the delivery while Inbound inspects the customer return.
fields.label: Warehouse Role

fields.description: Optional. Restrict this trigger to a single warehouse (matched against the source or target per Warehouse Role).
fields.label: Applicable Warehouse

fields.description: Optional Python expression evaluated against the transaction row, e.g. row.qty > 100.
fields.label: Condition

fields.description: Optional for Sample inspections: without a template the inspection is verdict-style (manual or ad-hoc readings). Each Quantity requires one, since the per-unit readings are generated from its parameters.
fields.label: Inspection Template

fields.description: Inbound: Quarantine routes stock to a Quality Control warehouse and locks it until release. Outbound: Block stops the document until inspection passes; Warn allows it with a warning. Periodic Re-test rows always quarantine.
fields.label: Quality Control Mode

fields.description: Sample: inspect a subset and accept/reject the lot. Each Quantity: inspect every unit (per-unit readings).
fields.label: Inspection Basis
